scope: Informational intent only. The head-to-head question is answered on the comparison page and redirected there.
stage0_note: The combination ledger holds seven papers that genuinely name both compounds, which is more than most stacks on this site have. None gives both to the same person. The most useful of them is a 2001 study finding that both inhibit the same enzyme in human serum, which bears directly on whether stacking them adds anything.

serp_2026-09-24.note: A Reddit thread second, then clinics, two pharmacies and a vendor selling both in one spray. One of the ranking pages argues against stacking, which is unusual enough to be worth noting.

h1: Selank and semax together: seven studies name both, none gave both to a person, and at one measured point they do the same thing
dek: The pair is sold in a single nasal spray and stacked routinely. The literature naming both is larger than for most combinations on this site, and what it shows is not what the stacking case assumes: at the one biochemical point where both have been measured in the same experiment, they inhibit the same enzyme.

information_gain: The only page to read the seven studies that name both compounds and report what each one is: a brain-imaging study that gave each to different groups, a rat Parkinson's model, a cytokine study, a stem-cell toxicity screen, a forensic analysis of seized products, a transcriptome study of the tripeptide they share, and a 2001 experiment finding that both inhibit the same enkephalin-degrading enzyme in human serum. That last one is the page's argument: the case for stacking assumes complementary action, and the one measurement made on both in the same system found them doing the same thing. Combined with the shared Pro-Gly-Pro tail, which is itself active, the pharmacological case for the pair is weaker than the marketing and weaker than the intuition. And the only page to point out that a combined nasal spray fixes a ratio and a schedule that no study chose, for two compounds whose Western forms are acetylated analogues that no trial has tested at all.
serp_format_rewarded: A cited page in a results set led by a Reddit thread. The best commercial page carries five citations and a protocol; the sceptical clinician page carries none. Reading the seven papers is unopposed.
open_actions: The acetylated forms sold in the West are untested individually and in combination; recorded as a measured absence on the comparison page and repeated here.
Each component's record carries its dose detail and takes those queries.
